description: We are building an interactive web experience for the Abandoned but not Forgotten challenge to tell the stories of NASA's hardware left behind on the Moon and Mars.
summary:
Left Behind
What NASA Left on the Moon and Mars

Left Behind is an interactive 3D website that shows the equipment and objects NASA left on the Moon and Mars, like landers, rovers, flags and scientific instruments. You can spin and zoom the Moon or Mars, tap a yellow marker on a landing site, and see what was left there, when, and whether it is still active or silent. The website works in English and Arabic, on desktop and mobile. Our goal is to help students and the public learn about space exploration in a fun and easy way. The information comes from NASA mission records, and this is an unofficial educational project that is not affiliated with NASA.
In conclusion :

An interactive 3D website that shows what NASA left on the Moon and Mars, in English and Arabic.
